subject.name: Art and Design
subject.description: Art and Design syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: 1.2 HISTORY OF ZAMBIAN ART
topics.description: Explores Post-Independence Contemporary Art, Traditional Decorations, and Traditional Artifacts in Zambia.

sub_topics.name: 1.2.3 POST-INDEPENDENCE CONTEMPORARY ART
sub_topics.description: In this subtopic, learners will study Post Independence Contemporary Art in Zambia which reflects the country’s cultural heritage and modern influences. Characterized by a blend of traditional and modern styles, Zambian artists address local themes like poverty, inequality, and environmental concerns.

sub_topics.name: 1.2.4 TRADITIONAL DECORATIONS
sub_topics.description: Traditional decorations in Zambia are a vibrant reflection of the country’s rich cultural heritage and diversity. These decorations feature a range of artistic expressions, including intricately woven basketry, carved wood items, colourful textiles, and beautiful beadwork.

sub_topics.name: 1.2.5 TRADITIONAL ARTIFACTS
sub_topics.description: Traditional artefacts in Zambia are physical objects that hold significant cultural, historical, and spiritual value to the country’s diverse communities. These artefacts can include masks, sculptures, Textiles and jewellery.

topics.name: 1.5 GRAPHIC DESIGN
topics.description: Covers graphic design principles including poster making and computer-aided design.

sub_topics.name: 1.5.1 POSTER MAKING
sub_topics.description: In this subtopic, learners will explore the art of Poster making, focusing on how to convey important messages related to cross-cutting issues such as conservation and social activities. Through creative design, learners will learn to express ideas visually.

competencies.description: 1.5.1.1 Design various posters on crosscutting issues to convey messages.

sub_topics.name: 1.5.2 COMPUTER AIDED DESIGN (CAD)
sub_topics.description: Computer Aided Design (CAD) is a powerful tool used by designers to create precise drawings and models. This topic will introduce learners to the fundamentals of CAD and its application in designing various types of cards and models.

competencies.description: 1.5.2.1 Design various types of cards using a computer

topics.name: 1.6 PATTERN AND DESIGN
topics.description: The topic discusses patterns and designs around the environment, shaping our emotions, behaviours and interactions. Patterns influence our experiences through various forms.

competencies.description: Creative and innovation, analytical thinking, collaboration, problem solving skills.

sub_topics.name: 1.6.1 PATTERNS
sub_topics.description: In this topic, the focus is aligned with Pattern design which is the creation of repeating designs or motifs, often used to add visual interest and beauty to various surfaces, objects and materials.

topics.name: 1.7 DRAWING AND OR PAINTING FROM IMAGINATION
topics.description: This topic will help learners unlock the power of their imagination, it will give them freedom to explore their thoughts, emotions, experiences and express them in a visual language.

competencies.description: creative and innovation, analytical thinking, collaboration, communication.

sub_topics.name: 1.7.1 IMAGINATIVE COMPOSITIONS
sub_topics.description: Imaginative Composition is the creative process of arranging visual elements and principles to convey visual representations, ideas, emotions or stories.

competencies.description: 1.7.1.1 Compose pictures based on a given theme

topics.name: 1.8 DRAWING AND OR PAINTING FROM OBSERVATION
topics.description: Drawing and painting from observation is a fundamental skill for artists, allowing them to accurately capture the world around them.

competencies.description: Analytical Thinking, Communication, Creativity and Innovation, Collaboration, Critical Thinking

sub_topics.name: 1.8.1 DRAWING OR PAINTING FROM NATURAL OR MAN–MADE OBJECTS
sub_topics.description: Drawing and painting from observation enhances learner’s ability to capture the world around them accurately. This topic focuses on observing and representing both Natural and Man-made objects through various drawing techniques.

competencies.description: 1.8.1.1 Draw and or paint pictures from observation

topics.name: 1.9 DRAWING AND OR PAINTING FROM STILL LIFE
topics.description: In this topic, the learners will acquire skills such as, creativity, observation and analytical thinking. Still life drawing and painting is an artistic style that captures the aesthetics and essence of static objects, often arranged in deliberate compositions.

sub_topics.name: 1.9.1 STILL LIFE DRAWING AND OR PAINTING
sub_topics.description: Still life drawing and painting offers numerous benefits that can enhance skills, creativity and overall artistic growth. Fundamental skills like; Observation, form rendering and color theory are developed.

topics.name: 1.10 FIGURE DRAWING
topics.description: The topic will discuss the fundamental skills like proportion, pose, gesture and line art. Stick-Figure introduces the learners to basics on the use of line and shape in order to create simple imagery.

competencies.description: Analytical Thinking, Collaboration, Communication, Creativity and Innovation, Critical Thinking

sub_topics.name: 1.10.1. STICK FIGURE DRAWING
sub_topics.description: Stick Figure Drawing is a creative process that involves generating visual representations on a two-dimensional surface, such as paper, canvas, or digital screens.

topics.name: 1.11 CRAFTS IN 2D
topics.description: This topic focuses on the exploration and creation of two-dimensional art forms, emphasizing the development of essential skills such as analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration. Learners experiment with different materials and methods to express ideas visually while enhancing their understanding of artistic concepts.

sub_topics.name: 1.11.1 PICTURE MAKING
sub_topics.description: Explores various two-dimensional composition methods such as collage, montage, mosaic, and frieze, enabling learners to express thoughts and emotions through visual storytelling.

sub_topics.name: 1.11.2 WEAVING
sub_topics.description: Exposes learners to the definition, materials, and techniques of weaving, involving the interlacing of threads or flexible materials to create textiles and decorative items.

topics.name: 1.12 CRAFTS IN 3D
topics.description: This topic covers the creation of three-dimensional objects using various materials and techniques. It allows learners to express creativity and imagination by producing both traditional and modern crafts.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.1 BOOK CRAFT
sub_topics.description: Provides skills and knowledge to design and create handmade books using techniques such as bookbinding, design, and craftsmanship.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.2 PAPIER-MÂCHÉ CRAFT
sub_topics.description: Explores the traditional art of creating objects by layering paper strips or pulp with adhesive materials onto bases or molds.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.3 GENERAL CRAFTS
sub_topics.description: Covers a broad range of hand-made craft activities using found materials such as paper, fabric, and wood to develop cutting, shaping, and assembling skills.

competencies.description: Make various items using found materials

topics.name: 1.13 SCULPTURE
topics.description: Focuses on the art of making solid, three-dimensional figures viewable from all sides ('in the round'). It introduces learners to freestanding and relief forms ranging from small figurines to life-size statues.

sub_topics.name: 1.13.1 INTRODUCTION TO SCULPTURE
sub_topics.description: Introduces fundamental concepts, types, and approaches in sculpture making, encouraging experimentation with local materials.

competencies.description: Experimenting with basic approaches in sculpture making

sub_topics.name: 1.13.2 CONSTRUCTION AND ASSEMBLAGE
sub_topics.description: Focuses on creating three-dimensional artworks by combining, joining, and assembling various recyclable and found materials.

sub_topics.name: 1.13.3 CARVING
sub_topics.description: Exposes learners to subtractive sculptural techniques involving cutting or chipping away parts of materials like wood, stone, or soap to create forms.

topics.name: 1.14 ENTREPRENEURSHIP
topics.description: Explores the intersection of art and business, teaching learners how to leverage their artistic skills and creativity to launch viable business ventures.

sub_topics.name: 1.14.1 ENTREPRENEURSHIP IN ART
sub_topics.description: Guides learners on turning artistic passion into sustainable business enterprises such as art studios, custom painting, craft production, digital services, and exhibitions.
